reviews.title: Exactly What I Needed for Precision Gaming
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the Logitech G440 for a few weeks now, and I have to say—it’s made a noticeable difference in my gaming setup. As someone who plays a lot of competitive shooters like Valorant and Apex, I needed something that offered low-friction movement without sacrificing control. This mouse pad nails it. Right out of the box, the hard surface feels durable and premium. It’s not your typical soft fabric pad; instead, it has a smooth polymer surface that lets my Logitech G Pro X Superlight glide effortlessly. Tracking is accurate, and I haven't noticed any stuttering or cursor jump, which is essential when aiming quickly or making micro-adjustments in-game. The rubber base keeps it firmly in place even during longer sessions or high-intensity moments, and it doesn’t curl at the edges like some of the cheaper pads I’ve used in the past. I was also pleasantly surprised by how easy it is to clean—just a quick wipe and it's good as new. One thing to keep in mind: if you're used to cloth pads, there is a learning curve with the speed and glide. But once you adjust, it’s hard to go back. Whether you’re gaming competitively or just want more precision in your daily mouse use, this is a solid, well-made pad that delivers on what it promises. Highly recommend for anyone looking to upgrade from a standard mouse pad.
reviews.author: Danny C.

reviews.title: Very, very good mouse pad at a good price.
reviews.comment: The Logitech G440 is incredibly smooth and feels high-quality the moment you lay your hand on it. The low-friction surface lets my mouse glide effortlessly, and it’s noticeably improved the overall feel and precision of my games. Solid build, great performance—definitely worth it.
reviews.author: Jon

reviews.title: Replaces Corsair Hard Pads
reviews.comment: Been looking for an alternative ever since Corsair discontinued their line of hard mouse pads. This one fills the gap. Love it, super smooth and glides perfectly when paired with G502 Hero.
reviews.author: Lawrence

reviews.title: Very good but does wear out with time
reviews.comment: Works great. Very smooth and accurate mouse action. The only knock is that these pads do wear out in the area where you do most of your mousing as the area becomes TOO smooth and you start to get increased friction. I guess you have to move to glass pads for more durability but I've read those are coated and the coating wears off so maybe not.
reviews.author: Alexander

reviews.title: Well worth the dollars spent.
reviews.comment: Two days in, and I truly like this mouse pad. I've used pretty much the same size pad for over ten years, which is foam-backed fabric. It has served me well, yet until now, I didn't know how much it didn't serve me. This Logitech hard mouse pad is literally a game-changer. I'm using a Razer Basilisk V3 35K mouse that is working fantastically on this pad. Movement is smooth and quick, the thickness of the pad does not hinder movement or comfort, and it stays in place. Well worth the dollars spent.
reviews.author: Shindoru
